import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
L='/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/new-twenty-2026-10-31/list-color-threshold-primary-qualification-claude-r1'
import json,re
a=json.load(open(L+'/inputs/accepted57-scopes.json',encoding='utf-8'))['records']
p=json.load(open(L+'/inputs/prior39-scopes.json',encoding='utf-8'))
recs=[('A',x) for x in a]+[('P',x) for x in p['prior30']+p['next9']]
print(len(recs))
pat=re.compile(r'list.?colou?r|chromatic polynomial|list color function|choosab|K_\{2|K_\{s|threshold',re.I)
for tag,x in recs:
    t=json.dumps(x)
    hits=sorted(set(m.group(0).lower() for m in pat.finditer(t)))
    if hits:
        print(tag,x.get('mathdb_id'),x.get('mathdb_ids'),str(x.get('title'))[:90],hits)
x=p['prior30'][25]
print('REC26',x.get('title'),x.get('mathdb_id'),x.get('related_mathdb_id'),x.get('path'),str(x.get('scope'))[:300])
print('n accepted with mathdb ids',len({x.get('mathdb_id') for x in a}))
print('353552 present',any('353552' in json.dumps(x) for _,x in recs))
